ALTER TABLE student_learning_path
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',
    ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS is_primary BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_path
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS student_learning_path_student_id_key;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_path
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_student_learning_path_status,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_student_learning_path_primary_active;

ALTER TABLE student_learning_path
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_student_learning_path_status
        CHECK (status IN ('ACTIVE','PAUSED','COMPLETED','ARCHIVED')),
    ADD CONSTRAINT ck_student_learning_path_primary_active
        CHECK (NOT is_primary OR status = 'ACTIVE');

-- Before this migration Student allowed only one row per learner, so every
-- existing path is both the primary path and the selected active context.
UPDATE student_learning_path
SET status = 'ACTIVE', is_primary = TRUE;

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_learning_path_primary
    ON student_learning_path (student_id) WHERE is_primary;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_path_student_recent
    ON student_learning_path (student_id, updated_at DESC, id DESC);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS uq_student_learning_path_context_reference
    ON student_learning_path (id, student_id, status);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_context (
    student_id UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    selected_learning_path_id UUID,
    selected_path_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE'
        CHECK (selected_path_status = 'ACTIVE'),
    version BIGINT NOT NULL CHECK (version >= 1),
    updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT fk_student_learning_context_active_path
        FOREIGN KEY (selected_learning_path_id, student_id, selected_path_status)
        REFERENCES student_learning_path (id, student_id, status)
);

INSERT INTO student_learning_context
    (student_id, selected_learning_path_id, selected_path_status, version, updated_at)
SELECT student_id, id, 'ACTIVE', 1, updated_at
FROM student_learning_path
ON CONFLICT (student_id) DO NOTHING;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS student_learning_path_request (
    idempotency_key UUID PRIMARY KEY,
    planning_request_id UUID NOT NULL UNIQUE,
    student_id UUID NOT NULL,
    student_learning_path_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES student_learning_path(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    request_hash CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (student_id, planning_request_id)
);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_student_learning_path_request_student
    ON student_learning_path_request (student_id, created_at DESC);
